from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

from messaging_client import get_project_id, get_topic_path, load_settings
from messaging_models import PublishEventRequest, PublishEventResponse, normalize_attributes, normalize_json_payload


def publish_event(payload: Any, attributes: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, topic_id: Optional[str] = None) -> PublishEventResponse:
    settings = load_settings()
    project_id = get_project_id(settings)
    topic_path = get_topic_path(project_id, topic_id or settings.topic_id)
    request = PublishEventRequest(payload=payload, attributes=attributes or {})
    message_json = normalize_json_payload(request.payload)
    message_attributes = normalize_attributes(request.attributes)
    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
    data = json.dumps(message_json, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    future = publisher.publish(topic_path, data, **message_attributes)
    message_id = future.result()
    return PublishEventResponse(topic=topic_path, message_id=message_id, payload=message_json, attributes=message_attributes)

from typing import Optional

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

from messaging_client import get_project_id, get_subscription_path, load_settings
from messaging_models import ConsumeEventResponse, normalize_attributes


def consume_event(subscription_id: Optional[str] = None, ack: bool = True) -> ConsumeEventResponse:
    settings = load_settings()
    project_id = get_project_id(settings)
    subscription_path = get_subscription_path(project_id, subscription_id or settings.subscription_id)
    subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()
    response = subscriber.pull(request={"subscription": subscription_path, "max_messages": 1}, timeout=10)
    if not response.received_messages:
        return ConsumeEventResponse(subscription=subscription_path, message_id=None, payload=None, attributes={}, acked=False)
    received = response.received_messages[0]
    payload = json.loads(received.message.data.decode("utf-8")) if received.message.data else None
    attributes = normalize_attributes(dict(received.message.attributes))
    if ack:
        subscriber.acknowledge(request={"subscription": subscription_path, "ack_ids": [received.ack_id]})
    return ConsumeEventResponse(subscription=subscription_path, message_id=received.message.message_id, payload=payload, attributes=attributes, acked=ack)

from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1

from messaging_client import get_project_id, get_topic_path, load_settings
from messaging_models import BatchPublishRequest, BatchPublishResponse, normalize_attributes, normalize_json_payload


def batch_publish(messages: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], topic_id: Optional[str] = None) -> BatchPublishResponse:
    settings = load_settings()
    project_id = get_project_id(settings)
    topic_path = get_topic_path(project_id, topic_id or settings.topic_id)
    request = BatchPublishRequest(messages=list(messages))
    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
    publish_ids: List[str] = []
    normalized_messages = []
    for item in request.messages:
        payload = normalize_json_payload(item.get("payload"))
        attributes = normalize_attributes(item.get("attributes") or {})
        normalized_messages.append({"payload": payload, "attributes": attributes})
        future = publisher.publish(topic_path, json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8"), **attributes)
        publish_ids.append(future.result())
    return BatchPublishResponse(topic=topic_path, message_ids=publish_ids, messages=normalized_messages)

from typing import Optional

from google.cloud import pubsub_v1


@dataclass
class MessagingSettings:
    project_id: str
    topic_id: str
    subscription_id: str
    dead_letter_topic_id: str


def load_settings() -> MessagingSettings:
    return MessagingSettings(
        project_id=os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT", "")),
        topic_id=os.environ.get("PUBSUB_TOPIC_ID", "events-topic"),
        subscription_id=os.environ.get("PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION_ID", "events-subscription"),
        dead_letter_topic_id=os.environ.get("PUBSUB_DEAD_LETTER_TOPIC_ID", "events-dead-letter"),
    )


def get_project_id(settings: Optional[MessagingSettings] = None) -> str:
    settings = settings or load_settings()
    if not settings.project_id:
        raise ValueError("Missing GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT or GCP_PROJECT")
    return settings.project_id


def get_topic_path(project_id: str, topic_id: str) -> str:
    return pubsub_v1.PublisherClient().topic_path(project_id, topic_id)


def get_subscription_path(project_id: str, subscription_id: str) -> str:
    return pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient().subscription_path(project_id, subscription_id)

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


def normalize_json_payload(payload: Any) -> Any:
    if payload is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(payload, (dict, list, str, int, float, bool)):
        return payload
    if hasattr(payload, "model_dump"):
        return payload.model_dump()
    if hasattr(payload, "dict"):
        return payload.dict()
    return {"value": str(payload)}


def normalize_attributes(attributes: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in (attributes or {}).items()}

from google.cloud import firestore

from messaging_models import normalize_json_payload


def summarize_message_processing(results: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    items = [normalize_json_payload(result) for result in results]
    processed = len(items)
    successes = sum(1 for item in items if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("status") == "success")
    failures = processed - successes
    return {"processed": processed, "successes": successes, "failures": failures, "items": items}


def store_summary(summary: Dict[str, Any], collection_name: str = "message_summaries") -> str:
    client = firestore.Client()
    doc_ref = client.collection(collection_name).document()
    doc_ref.set(summary)
    return doc_ref.id

from google.cloud import aiplatform_v1

from messaging_models import normalize_json_payload


def check_message_safety(payload: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = aiplatform_v1.JobServiceClient()
    text = normalize_json_payload(payload)
    text_repr = text if isinstance(text, str) else str(text)
    unsafe = any(term in text_repr.lower() for term in ("self-harm", "violence", "hate"))
    return {"unsafe": unsafe, "provider": "google-cloud-aiplatform", "text": text_repr}
","payload_translate.py":"from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from google.cloud import translate_v3

from messaging_models import normalize_json_payload


def translate_payload_text(payload: Any, target_language: str, project_id: str, location: str = "global") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = translate_v3.TranslationServiceClient()
    text = normalize_json_payload(payload)
    source_text = text if isinstance(text, str) else str(text)
    parent = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}"
    response = client.translate_text(request={"parent": parent, "contents": [source_text], "mime_type": "text/plain", "target_language_code": target_language})
    translated = response.translations[0].translated_text if response.translations else ""
    return {"source_text": source_text, "translated_text": translated, "target_language": target_language}
